rootCause: Missing selected registry row fell back to a default-provider summary without providerId while preserving a different provider catalog draft.
resolution: Pin the first displayed provider ID; external default changes do not silently retarget form or child catalog drafts.
Resolve exact registry IDs only. Legacy fallback is limited to an actual initial single-provider response, never empty/malformed registries or a known registry becoming legacy-shaped.

Retain the last exact provider data and child catalog editor when that provider disappears. Display a removed-target warning, clear secret inputs/consent, disable save, directory actions and profile mutations, and hide stale login/default/removal actions.
Keep existing draft navigation and epoch guards. Explicit selection of another valid provider still asks before discarding catalog edits; known removed destinations cannot be selected.

When the exact same ID returns, retained catalog requires new capability consent and submits that ID/current revision. Explicit own removal selects a known remaining provider instead of reusing stale default metadata.

validation.method: Isolated jsdom React UI with actual Api and IndexedDB operation persistence; intercepted fetch transport only. Includes submit events and stale retained buttons, no live backend/provider requests. Existing provider/catalog/profile/draft suites cover unknown results, late results and accepted own saves.
